# Unicode and Emoji Test 🚀

## Emojis in Headings 📝

Testing various Unicode characters and emojis:

- 🎯 Goal setting
- 💡 Ideas and insights
- ⚠️ Warnings and alerts
- ✅ Completed tasks
- 🔥 Hot topics

## Non-Latin Scripts

### Greek
Αυτό είναι ελληνικό κείμενο (This is Greek text)

### Japanese
これは日本語のテキストです (This is Japanese text)

### Arabic
هذا نص عربي (This is Arabic text)

### Emoji Combinations

Weather today: ⛅🌡️ 18°C

Mood: 😊➡️😴➡️☕➡️🚀

Math: 2 × 3 ÷ 6 ≈ 1
